node.title: Optimization, Coherence, and the Frame
node.reading:
Why a system optimizing on its own map cannot see the map; why coherence — not rationality — is the mode that sees it; and why a purely maximizing agent is structurally blind to exactly the capabilities that keep a system alive.

Document Status — Working Paper 2 · Series: Informational Friction (a systems theory)

Builds on Paper 1 ( The Map and the Flow ), which established the object: a representation used as a control surface, diverging from the flow it governs, with back-action. This paper supplies the agent-level mechanism beneath that object. The forward forecasts (the Outlook) and the consolidated falsification battery are deferred to later papers in the series; falsifiable claims are marked inline.

relations: Scenario selection optimizes within a declared frame; questioning that frame is a separate governance act.
El score xSeil no detecta por sí mismo todos los errores del marco. La analogía no convierte al operador en árbitro externo de verdad.
Cross-frame coherence is assessed against an independently specified upstream outcome, making the map–flow argument operational without equating every deviation with value.
No todo incumplimiento es coherencia y un objetivo del cliente puede ser inválido en un marco social o legal más amplio.
Process conformance identifies a path difference; outcome and counterfactual evidence are still needed to establish whether the deviation preserved the upstream result.
No canonizar heroísmos, fraude ni atajos inseguros por producir una salida local. El marco receptor debe permanecer explícito.
The team is an integrated system when its specialist decisions preserve the same independently stated mission outcome, not merely when every member completes a local deliverable.
La coherencia declarada por el equipo no sustituye aceptación del receptor ni autoriza infringir límites externos.
Functional trust can support early disclosure of uncertainty when protecting the mission requires giving up a locally favourable account of progress.
La confianza no prueba coherencia y el desacuerdo puede ser correcto; conservar canales de revisión y contraste independientes.
The UP move can expose alternatives outside a local frame, while an independently stated upstream outcome is needed to judge whether the new perspective is coherent.
Un cambio de perspectiva personal no prueba coherencia ni autoriza a imponer un objetivo elegido por el facilitador.
The same network can contain harmful local optimization and useful off-map adaptation; their sign becomes clear only after the upstream outcome and its recipient are specified.
La lectura está expresamente propuesta en la fuente; no elimina las obligaciones de seguridad, derechos o legitimidad del servicio.
The territorial dimension makes the frame explicit: an operating outcome must be evaluated against the affected recipients and obligations, not only the contractor's local target.
La relación conceptual no verifica cumplimiento de derechos en un caso concreto ni otorga representación sobre comunidades.
